name: Flythrough
description: Fly a real 3D camera through a screenshot. The picture lifts into layers at real depth; big shapes extrude into solid objects; a timeline of poses animates the whole move - depth, opacity, perspective, extrusion, tilt, rotate, scale and the camera flight - then loops it home. Add, drag and reorder poses. Export as video.

inputs.label: Screenshot
inputs.help: Pick or upload the image to fly through. An SVG lifts into real layers for parallax + extrusion; a bitmap flies as one plane.

inputs.label: Camera flight
inputs.help: A preset flight, or Custom to drive the camera (distance + height) from the poses. Depth, opacity, extrusion, tilt, rotate and scale animate across the poses under ANY flight - except Still, which holds the FIRST pose static so you can configure a single pose without matching Start and End.

inputs.label: Isometric (no perspective)
inputs.help: Switch to a real orthographic camera - parallel projection, no perspective convergence. Combine with Tilt + Rotate for a true isometric. Perspective (FOV) is disabled while this is on.

inputs.label: Seconds
inputs.help: Length of the move. Match the export Duration for a clean loop.

inputs.label: Loop home
inputs.help: On: eases out to End then reverses home (seamless loop). Off: plays once, Start → End.

inputs.label: Reverse poses
inputs.help: Play the poses back to front - a one-click fix when you built the move backwards. The pose list stays as-is; only the play direction flips.

inputs.label: Light
inputs.help: How hard the key light rakes across the extruded side walls - higher gives the solids more form and contrast.

inputs.label: Shadow
inputs.help: Strength of the soft shadow each layer casts on the one behind it.

inputs.label: Studio floor
inputs.help: A soft showroom floor shadow pooled under the base - wider than the subject and receding along the floor. 0 is off.

inputs.label: Floor: anchor to viewport
inputs.help: Off: the floor is anchored to the subject and tilts with it (a diorama the camera flies around). On: the floor stays a fixed horizontal ground in the viewport while the subject tilts above it.

inputs.label: Poses
inputs.help: The keyframes of the move. The first pose is the start, the last is the end; add poses in between and drag to reorder. The animation tweens across them (Loop reverses home). Every pose carries the full state - depth, opacity, extrusion, scale, tilt, rotate, perspective (FOV), and the custom-flight camera distance + height.

fields.label: Depth
fields.help: Layer separation. Low is near-flat; higher explodes the stack.

fields.label: Opacity
fields.help: Layer opacity. 0 is fully invisible - animate from 0 for a FORMING effect.

fields.label: Extrusion
fields.help: Thickness of the big shapes (cards, panels, logos). 0 is flat.

fields.label: Tilt X (pitch)
fields.help: Pitch - tip the subject back or forward about the horizontal axis. Toward ±90° the far edge recedes to a horizon.

fields.label: Tilt Y (yaw)
fields.help: Yaw - turn the subject left or right about the vertical axis, like a door. ±180 is a full sweep.

fields.label: Tilt Z (roll)
fields.help: Roll - bank the subject in its own plane (rotate it clockwise/anti-clockwise as you look at it).

fields.label: Move X
fields.help: Slide the subject left / right within the frame. Or Shift-drag the canvas.

fields.label: Move Y
fields.help: Slide the subject up / down within the frame - e.g. to lift a subject cut off at the bottom. Or Shift-drag the canvas.

fields.label: Perspective
fields.help: Lens field-of-view. Wider exaggerates the depth. Ignored when Isometric is on.

fields.label: Camera distance
fields.help: Custom flight only: 1 frames the whole stack; lower dives in among the layers.

fields.label: Camera height
fields.help: Custom flight only: raise or lower the lens.

inputs.label: Custom camera path
inputs.help: A keyframe track in Lolly's kf wire (e.g. t0_rx0_ry-30*t3000_eo_rx-20_ry30). Overrides the flight above - same format as the Design tool's camera, so it's URL-shareable.
